lines: How did I end up in a situation like thisー
I sat alone on the corner of the bed, stiff in every sense of the word.
(R-Relax... stay calm, stay calm... and... take a deep breath...)
The quiet sound of the door made heart pound.
Sorry for the wait. You can use the bath now.
The woman wiped her faintly steaming body with a bath towel.
(Whoa! Too close... I-I can, I can see...)
Her overly voluptuous body couldn't be covered with a single bath towel.
More than half of her soft-looking breasts were spilling out of the towel, and if she only spread her legs a little, then...
How about you take a bath too? You worked up a sweat, didn't you?
As she spoke, she sat down next to me. Her moist skin and warmth came ever closer.
N-No... I don't dislike it, but... um...
I could no longer do anything but look down and shrink away, but then her milky white thighs and a suggestive triangle were catching my eyes...
The moisture remaining there conjured thoughts of something even more obscene.
I reluctantly turned to the side and saw she was staring at me with mischievous eyes through her foggy glasses.
I was desperately trying to find something harmless to talk about.
Aahh, I'm sorry. I haven't even told you my name yet. I'm Shizuru. And you?
Ah, um... my name is Fuma Kotaro. But that's more like... how should I put it... the name of my family, I guess...
Hmm... I'll call you Fuma-kun then! Nice to meet you♪ Alright then, go and wash up! If you do, I'll do something nice for you afterwards♪
I replied, but was unable to change my posture at all. If I stood up, the state of my crotch would become obvious.
What's wrong? Boys who don't bathe can't partake in anything with me, you know?
(I-It's your fault I can't stand up!! Something is already standing though!)
(Damn it... you don't even know what I'm going through...)
There were women like her who somehow always showed too much skin, or touched a man's body casually...
Even though they might not mean anything by it, for the man it could become quite stressful. If he acted on it but was mistaken, a lifetime of being treated like a stalker awaited him.
...Though even as I acted indignant about it, a certain something was still raging and showed no signs of calming down.
(Only one thing to do in such a situation... To recall the three things I've witnessed in my life at the top of my turn-off rankings...)
Oh my, you closed your eyes. Are you perhaps tired?
My efforts were quickly shattered by the sensation of something soft against my arm.
It all had begun a few hours agoー
In Maesaki, the closest city to Gosha Village.
It might be the closest city, but was still about 3 hours by train and bus.
At best it was peaceful, at worst it was a deserted smaller city, but recently it had abruptly regained some liveliness.

It had been designated as part of the government's Regional Development Policy, receiving benefits like preferential tax treatment, which had lead to large companies, both national and international, settling in the city.
Stores and recreational facilities had quickly followed, and now it was even being featured on TV as a trendy area.
It's the first trip to the city in a long time, Fuma-chan!!!
Compared to Tokyo it's still the countryside though.
Compared to Gosha Village it's still a big city!
It's a shame that Shikanosuke-chan couldn't come. Especially since Asagi-sensei was nice enough to provide some time off and pocket money.
Don't call it "pocket money," it's a reward. ...Why could Shikanosuke suddenly not come with us?
Apparently he has mumps. So he's quarantined in his room.
Is he a little kid or something!!!?
We of the Independent Commando Unit had continually carried out difficult missions right from the time of its formation, so we were all a bit tired.
Asagi-sensei had noticed and said, "You guys have been working hard lately, so why don't you let your hair down once in a while?"
And she had given us some reward money and time off.
(...You really are unlucky, Shikanosuke. We'll make sure to properly spend your portion of the money though!)
Hey Fuma-chan, let's go shopping! At Maruju Building in front of the station♪
There's a dress that Hebiko wants♪
Then go alone! There's only women in a place like that... I'm gonna go to an arcade.
...Hebiko has always done as Fuma-chan asks, no?
Saving you from Gaiza... and even using her legs to block bullets~ That hurt so much~
Alright, alright! I get it! I just have to go with you, right?!!
Hebiko grabbed my arm and started walking.
Let's grab something to eat first. Let's have a crepe!
A crepe!? Are we students or something!?
Aaaahー! That was great♪ Let's go to the mame daifuku shop next! It was featured in a magazine♪
You okay? You look a bit pale.
...Didn't you just want to buy a dress!?
Crepes, takoyaki, cake at a cafe!!! And now mame daifuku!? No matter how you look at it, it's overeating... Ueeoghh...
Th-There's always room for dessert!!! In Gosha Village there's only Inageya's ice cream...
So Hebiko needs to eat as much as possible when she gets the chance...
It seemed like Hebiko was planning to eat even more.
Before I knew it, the sun was beginning to set. If this continued, my day off would have been spent just stuffing my face.
I'm gonna take this opportunity to tell you that you've gained weight lately...!!!
I played a special attack card that had a "1000% attack bonus against women."
...H-Hebiko d-didn't get fat!! ...It's just that Hebiko's tentacles became a bit sturdier...
There's no way you're only "sturdier" when you turn into an octopus!! Shikanosuke said so too. You're turning into a kraken!!!
Tears began to well up in Hebiko's eyes.
...What the hell!! Have you ever even seen a kraken!?!!
Fuma-chan and Shikanosuke-chan, you're both awful!!! Go get crushed by a whale and die!!! Uwaaaah!!!
Hebiko tore us a new one and then dashed away... directly toward the mame daifuku shop.
With that, I was finally alone. My precious day off had almost ended with only spending time with Hebiko.
I'm sorry Hebiko, but unless I did something drastic you wouldn't have let me go.
What a clever guy I am. Hehehe... huh?
What's wrong, Hebiko? Did you forget something? And why did you turn into an octopus...?
Hebiko showered me in octopus ink and ran off again.
I was left standing alone, pitch black from head to toe.
...Turning into an octopus in broad daylight... Asagi-sensei will be mad if a picture with the title "rare species sighted" turns up on the internet...
But for now it was me, completely covered in pitch black ink, who was having his picture taken by passersby.
I was walking through the downtown area after dark, enveloped in the smell of fishiness.
This was my precious chance to come here... Hebiko, you'll pay for this...
After Hebiko had showered me with ink, I had quickly run into the closest coin-operated shower and washed my whole body.
I looked clean enough, but the smell just wouldn't go away.
Apparently the foul stench of Hebiko's ink wouldn't come off for three full days.
(Nothing I can do about that now...)
The neon-lit city at night! If I kept worrying about the smell, I wouldn't be able to enjoy it at all.
When a city came to life, downtown areas like this would thrive behind the scenes.
It was insignificant compared to Yomihara the Underground City or to Tokyo Kingdom, but still...
This area as well, once a remote backstreet, was slowly starting to become a black market district.
Citizens of the underworld, traffickers, prostitutes, and all sorts of demons were starting to gather. I couldn't get enough of the crude and vulgar atmosphere they created.
Normally I would just go home after getting a taste of this air, but...
(But today I still have the reward from Asagi-sensei! Besides, thanks to Shikanosuke not being able to join us, my share even went up by 50%!)
I'll enjoy this night to the fullest!! With this money, a great feast shall be had!!! To the other side of pleasure, and beyond!!!!

Horned Girl: Look at that guy.
Black-Winged Girl: Yeah, he's still young, but... what a pity.
Horned Girl: And he kinda smells like fish.
Oh damn, apparently I had unconsciously yelled out my inner voice. Two young girls stared at me with a disappointed look.
Hmm...??? Wait, what are you two??? You don't look human.
We are just some demons passing by, boy!
No need to be afwaid! We are nice demons.
So they were demons. Come to think of it, recently you often heard about low-ranking demons causing trouble in black market districts like this.
Are you beggars? Pickpockets? Unfortunately I have nothing to give you. Shoo shoo!

Horned Girl: Beggars!!?
Black-Winged Girl: H-How wude...!!!?
The demons fluttered their wings in an attempt to intimidate me. They weren't scary at all though.
You're persistent, aren't you. Get out of here already if you don't want to get hurtー
An Orc with a scuffed-up gun and a young demon with a strange aura emanating from his arm had appeared. They looked just like guards of shady cities.
The demon girls turned pale. They seemed to know what this was about. Not that it concerned me though.
Looks like someone came to pick you up. I'll be going then. A beautiful woman is waiting for me somewhereー
I turned on my heel to leave, but the girls grabbed my arm and suddenly shouted something completely unexpected.

Horned Girl: Th-Those guys are after us, Chief!!
Black-Winged Girl: Will you get wid of them!?
They didn't seem to be addressing those guards. Then that meant...
Chief... don't tell me you mean me?
There's no one else here apart fwom you, Chief!!!
As they said that, they hid behind me and faced the guards.
Chief, you say...!? Hey, bro!!! Are you responsible for those brats?
You want to "get rid of us?" You've got some balls!
When our chief gets serious, guys like you are a piece of cake!
That's wight! He may not look like it, but our chief can spit fire and cwush your bones!
Hey, hey, hold on!! I can what...!!!? You damn kids...
When I turned around to demand an explanation, the two of them were already running away like scared rabbits.
Chief, we'll leave the rest to youーーー!!
Don't wowwy about us and fight with them as much as you wantー!!
Alllllright, looks like you're the one who's going to pay for this...
I'm gonna cut off your head and slice it into pieces...!
That wasn't good. No matter how you looked at it, it obviously seemed like I was the chief who had come forward to let those brats get away safely.
